system.description: A field of magnetism around you pulls incoming, ranged, metallic projectile attacks (such as arrows, bullets, a thrown metal knife, and so on) to the ground. It also disperses energy attacks such as electricity, x-rays, lasers, and other attacks that are part of the electromagnetic spectrum. You are immune to such attacks for one round. You must be aware of an attack to foil it. Enabler.
